```{r, loading-libraries-and-functions}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false

# libraries
library(here)
library(ggplot2) 
library(dplyr) 
source(here::here("pages", "project", "src", "functions", "save_plot_as_png.R"))
```


```{r, getting-data}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false

# call script to read clean/wrangle and write data for later use 
source(here::here("pages", "project", "src", "data", "data_cleaning.R"))

# read data
mtcars <- readRDS(here::here("pages", "project", "data", "mtcars.Rds"))
```

```{r, plot-mpg-by-hp}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# create plot
# recommendation: always save plots as png so that you have an easily accessible
# plot file available for other purpose (slide, sharing, etc.); extracting plots
# from a webpage manually is more difficult 
# then embed the png into the webpage 

p <- 
  mtcars |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = hp, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r, saveplot-mpg}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false

# save the plot as a .png file using the save_plot_as_png()
save_plot_as_png(
  plot = p,
  file_name = "mpg-by-hp.png"
)
```

```{r, plot-mpg-by-wt-for-cyl}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# create plot for subset
p <- 
  mtcars |>
  # get only 6 cylinder cars
  filter(cyl %in% 4:6) |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point()
```

<!-- SAVE PLOT AS PNG -->

```{r, saveplot-cyl-subset}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false

# save the plot as a .png file using the save_plot_as_png()
save_plot_as_png(
  plot = p,
  file_name = "mpg-by-wt-for-cyl.png"
)
```
